payload.parent_proof_nl: Assume the hypothesis: g is nonincreasing on [a,b), meaning that for all real x,y with a <= x <= y < b, one has g(y) <= g(x). Now let x,y be any real numbers satisfying a <= x <= y < b. Applying the hypothesis directly to this pair (x,y), we obtain g(y) <= g(x). This is exactly the conclusion. Therefore the statement holds.

x is not greater than y: x <= y
y is strictly less than b: y < b
x and y are real numbers
g is defined on all real numbers

quantifier_order: for all real x, y with a <= x <= y < b: g(y) <= g(x)
